summary: Fix in packages/dispatch/web/src/features/conversation/ConversationTab.tsx: compute one loading (any of the three reads pending) and failed (any read errored) predicate above the useFollowLatest call, use it for the two early returns, and pass latestItemSeq undefined while loading || failed || shown is empty, so the hook's one first placement runs in the commit that first renders the list. use-follow-latest.ts gets only its latestItemSeq doc updated. Option B (a hook-level guard on [data-turn]) is rejected: when the held read answers last without changing the newest time no effect dependency changes, so the effect never re-runs.
tasks: 1. Pod harness per docs/solutions/testing/a-browser-harness-in-an-issue-pod-lives-on-the-issue-volume-INFRA-43.md and the INFRA-95 pg_isready delta, under /legion/harness (setup.sh + env.sh), own five-port lane and DATABASE_URL; chromium + firefox browsers; WebKit is CI-only.

Commit 1: new row in packages/dispatch/e2e/phone-conversation.e2e.ts at a new 390x664 viewport constant (the iPhone 13 viewport INFRA-95 measured; at 844 the composer sits below a turn left at y~515, so the row could not fail); seed one ask, one comment, 8 older messages, then the newest message; hold the tab's asks read by URL predicate (pathname /api/v1/issues/<KEY>/asks and thread=1), assert one hit, wait requestfinished on /messages and /comments plus two setTimeout(0), two rAFs and 300 ms, then route.continue(); settle = newest card's box unchanged for 30 samples 50 ms apart (bounded 20 s), no scroll/focus/click; one-shot toBeInViewport({ratio:1}) on ol[aria-label="Conversation turns"] [data-turn="message:<id>"] and a one-shot boxes-apart check against the Comment composer form (not expectUncovered, which polls); 20 unforced opens each on a new page (scrollY 0 asserted first, never reload); sensitivity guard at the end: scrollTo(0,0) and assert the newest card is not both in view and clear of the composer; test.setTimeout(240_000). Run `cd packages/dispatch && source /legion/harness/env.sh && bun run e2e -- --project=chromium --project=iphone --repeat-each=10 --grep "newest message in view whichever read answers last"`: 20/20 red at the in-view/composer assertion of the forced open.

decisions: Option A (tab withholds latestItemSeq while loading || failed) over option B (hook guard on [data-turn]); reason above.
The failed half also fixes the same symptom by a second path: one read failing after the other two answered, then a later refetch succeeding.
Unchanged and out of scope: leaving the tab before the reads finish and returning (IssuePage's restore overrides the first placement); a background refetch failing after the list was shown.
jumpToLatest's no-turn scrollTo(0) branch stays; with the fix the hook never reaches it without a card.
The row asserts the newest card ([data-turn]), not only its text, which is the spec's 'newest conversation'.
The row runs in chromium and iphone (both Chromium) only, not webkit-iphone: the fault is React effect ordering, and WebKit cannot launch in an issue pod.

The forced release margin is fixed (two setTimeout(0), two rAFs, 300 ms) because no in-page signal exists; the repeat-each 20/20 red is its proof, and a short red rate lengthens the margin rather than loosening the assertion.

findings.finding: Option B (hook skips first placement while no [data-turn]) cannot fix the reported order: no effect dependency changes when the held read answers last.
findings.answer: Plan chooses option A and records why B fails; one predicate drives both the early returns and latestItemSeq; per-case table of unchanged behaviour (deep link, tab return, filter, empty, phone thread, own send).

findings.finding: A read failing after the others answered spends the first placement on the error text too; two pre-existing edges (leave the tab mid-load and return; refetch failure after the list showed) are not caused by the race.
findings.answer: Predicate is pending || error across all three reads; the two edges are recorded as unchanged and out of scope.

findings.finding: No in-page signal tells the test the hook has seen the partial data before the release; a glob would also catch the margin's asks read.
findings.answer: URL predicate on pathname and thread=1 with a one-hit assertion; requestfinished on /messages and /comments plus a defended fixed margin; route.continue(); repeat-each 10 on both projects must be 20/20 red at the in-view/composer assertion.

findings.finding: The fault only shows at 390x664; 844 cannot fail; three seeded items may leave too little scroll room; the inverse guard cannot use the polling expectUncovered.
findings.answer: New 390x664 constant with its reason; 8 older messages for scroll room; one-shot apart check and a one-shot sensitivity guard at scrollY 0.

findings.finding: 'Once finished rendering' needs a checkable definition; expectUncovered's 5 s poll can pass transiently.
findings.answer: Settle = card box unchanged for 30 samples 50 ms apart (past the 1 s read dwell), then one-shot assertions.

findings.finding: Spec says the newest conversation; asserting only the text is another reading.
findings.answer: The row asserts the card [data-turn="message:<id>"] in ol[aria-label="Conversation turns"].

findings.finding: Each unforced open needs a cold page with no scroll restoration; 21 loads on two projects exceed the default 30 s timeout and cost CI time.
findings.answer: Each open on a new page with scrollY 0 asserted, never reload; test.setTimeout(240_000); CI cost named as a risk.
